subject: BrightWave onboarding demo — maintenance window + SE coverage gap
messages:
From: Sophie Zhang <sophie@brightwave.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + sandbox walkthrough request

Hi Olga / Ben / David,

Thanks again for the quick call last week. BrightWave is excited to move to a short sandbox walkthrough so our engineers and procurement can validate integration and licensing.

Goal: 45–60 minute run-through of the Redwood hosted API, example integration with our ingestion pipeline, and a quick check of auth/scoping.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 21 Jul, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 21 Jul, 15:00–16:00
- Wed 22 Jul, 09:30–10:30

If none of those work we can push to the following week. Procurement is on standby; I CC'd them and they'll need the SOC2 summary before we sign.

Thanks,
Sophie Zhang
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightWave AI

Attachment: integration-requirements.pdf (stub)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Zhang <sophie@brightwave.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightwave.ai, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + sandbox walkthrough request

Hi Sophie — great to hear. Thanks for proposing slots.

We can absolutely run a 60-minute walkthrough with an integration-focused agenda:
- 15m: brief product intro and endpoints
- 25m: live run-through with your sample data (auth + request patterns)
- 20m: Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

David (Engineer) will lead the technical portion. Monica from CS will cover onboarding steps and timing.

David and I are available for the two Tue slots you suggested (10:00 or 15:00 PT). If the team prefers Wed morning we can make that work too.

Proposed: Tue 21 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PT — I will send a calendar invite and include a short mutual action plan. Can you confirm procurement's SOC2 timing or if we should attach preliminary docs?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

--

From: Ian Murphy <ian@brightwave.ai>

Cc: Sophie Zhang <sophie@brightwave.ai>, procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick intro + sandbox walkthrough request — scheduling conflict

Hey all,

Apologies for the late note — infrastructure hit us with a mandatory maintenance window on Tue 21 Jul from 09:30–11:30 PT to apply a firmware update to our edge appliances. That overlaps the 10:00 slot Sophie proposed.

On top of that, our lead integration engineer (Mark) is traveling and will be offline that afternoon. Between the maintenance and Mark's travel, we don't have the right coverage at 10:00.

Really want to keep the walkthrough short and effective — would you be open to moving to Thu 23 Jul or Fri 24 Jul? Thu morning looks best for our team (10:00–11:00 PT), but we can be flexible.

Sorry for the churn — this one came from the infra calendar after we locked the slot.

Cheers,
Ian Murphy
Head of Platform Operations
BrightWave AI

Thanks for the heads up, Ian — understood on the maintenance. Appreciate you flagging Mark's travel too.

New plan: Thu 23 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PT (joined by David for technical coverage). I've held the slot on our side and sent a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightwave-demo-proposed

Attachments included for procurement and the integration lead:
- mutual_action_plan_brightwave.xlsx (action owners & deliverables)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (preliminary security summary)

Action items / next steps:
- Sophie / BrightWave: confirm attendee list (who from your engineering team will join) and whether you want a short pre-shared sample dataset (due Wed 22 Jul EOD).
- David / Redwood SE: prepare a 10–15 minute section on auth/scopes and rate-limiting best practices.
- Monica / CS: prepare onboarding timeline and provisioning checklist.

If anything else pops up, ping me and we can adjust — otherwise we look forward to Thu.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
